functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_blocked_between(a uuid, b uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from blocks
    where (blocker_id = a and blocked_id = b) or (blocker_id = b and blocked_id = a)
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_trade_party(t uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from trades where id = t and auth.uid() in (proposer_id, recipient_id)
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_trade_note(p_trade uuid, p_note text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if not is_trade_party(p_trade) then raise exception 'Only these two collectors can change this trade.'; end if;
  update trades set exchange_note = trim(p_note), updated_at = now() where id = p_trade;
end;
$function$
